title: Pointwise finite cohomological dimension preserves exact acyclic-term complexes
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with injective resolutions in C, and let F:C→D be additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let (r_i:D→E_i) be a family of functors, where each E_i has zero morphisms, each r_i preserves monomorphisms, and an object M of D is zero whenever every r_i(M) is zero. Suppose d_i∈ℕ and r_i(R^qF(X))=0 for every i, X∈C and q>d_i. For every exact unbounded cochain complex K in C [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose terms are F-acyclic [def-sp-acyclic], the termwise image F(K) is exact.

source.place: Pointwise variant of the finite-dimension argument in 07K7; source theorem Acyclic.map_of_rightAcyclic_of_forall_isZero and its complete dimension-shifting proof.

proof.text: For an exact K write the short exact cycle sequences 0→Z^{m-1}→K^{m-1}→Z^m→0. Since K^{m-1} is F-acyclic, the right-derived long exact sequence gives a monomorphism R^{q+1}F(Z^m)→R^{q+2}F(Z^{m-1}) for q≥0. Apply r_i, which preserves monomorphisms, and iterate d_i times. The target vanishes by the bound, so r_i(R^{q+1}F(Z^m))=0. Joint detection of zero objects implies that every cycle is F-acyclic.

Apply F to each cycle sequence. Left exactness and the vanishing of R^1F of its leftmost cycle make the image sequence short exact. Its epimorphism onto F(Z^m) followed by the monomorphic image of Z^m→K^m identifies the image of the differential with its kernel. Thus F(K) is exact in every degree. The empty detecting family is allowed only when every object of D is zero, in which case the conclusion still holds.

theorem Acyclic.map_of_rightAcyclic_of_forall_isZero {K : CochainComplex C ℤ}
    (hK : K.Acyclic) (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    {ι : Type*} {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Category* (E i)] [∀ i, HasZeroMorphisms (E i)]
    (r : ∀ i, D ⥤ E i)
    [∀ i, (r i).PreservesMonomorphisms] (hr : ∀ M : D, (∀ i, IsZero ((r i).obj M)) → IsZero M)
    (d : ι → ℕ) (hF : ∀ i (X : C) (q : ℕ), d i < q → IsZero ((r i).obj ((F.rightDerived q).obj X)))
    (hK' : ∀ n, F.rightAcyclic (K.X n)) :
    ((F.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj K).Acyclic
